title: Umbral
subtitle: Tenebris — darkness, silence, the End
text: Umbral blood is Tenebris: darkness, concealment, and the quiet between heartbeats. It is not malevolent. It is simply comfortable with what others fear to acknowledge, that shadow is not only an absence but a presence of its own. Blood tempered in Tenebris becomes patient and precise. The Umbral enzyme gives that patience a practical form.
